{{Quote|Do you want to know where you can find some of those blasted little buggers called Ewoks? I know the perfect place where you can find some and show them what a blaster does.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Endor}}</ref>}}
The '''Jinda Ritualist's Cave''' was a cave on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of Endor]]. It was used by the [[Jinda (Ewok)|Jinda]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] for [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] expeditions in the neighboring forests.<ref name="SWG:JRC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] visited the cave and collected a [[Pestilence]] pike.<ref name="SWG:RMWMIII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark III}}</ref>
